title: Reset Document Count
text:
Reset Document Count 
 Company" />
 Reset Document 
 Count 
 This interface 
 is applicable for reiniatialising the document number series. 
 Let’s assume 
 a purchase bill entry has been made. After doing so, the user can see 
 that the document numbers are in serial order. There might be instances 
 where a few bills need to be deleted from the sequence. 
 According to 
 the system, the next bill would start from the last updated document number. 
 For example, suppose there are three bills numbered 5, 6, and 7. If bills 
 5, 6, and 7 need to be deleted, the next bill would normally be numbered 
 8. 
 This is where 
 the Reset Document Count interface comes into play to reinitialise 
 the document number series. 
 Note, that the 
 user cannot customise the document number without this feature. If the 
 user wants documents numbered 5, 6, and 7 to be removed; the next documents 
 would be numbered 5 and so on, if modified through this interface. 
 This serves 
 as a security feature to ensure there are no discrepancies while resetting 
 the document count. 
 The condition 
 set in the system is: Last Document Number + 1 for a new document. 
 Users are 
 advised to exercise caution while using this feature and take proper approvals. 
 Steps to Use Reset Document Count Interface 
 Navigation 
 to Reset Document Count: 
 Administration > 
 Transaction > 
 Company > 
 Reset Document 
 Count 
 Enter data into the following fields: 
 Entry Type: Choose the preferred Entry 
 Type. 
 Select Financial Year: Choose the preferred 
 Financial Year (either current or previous). 
 Business Unit: Choose the preferred 
 Business Unit. 
 Document Type: Tag the preferred Document 
 Type for which the user wants to reset the document no. 
 Reinitialize No.: Enter the reinitialize 
 number; remember that the condition 
 set in the system is: Last Document Number + 1 for a new document. 
 Once 
 the above fields are filled, from the Reset Document Count dropdown, click 
 on Edit. 
 This 
 will unlock the Submit button. 
 Now, 
 click on Submit to save the entry.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Enterprise Config
text:
Enterprise Config 
 Company" />
 Enterprise 
 Config 
 Enterprise Config allows us to set up the Enterprise. 
 This setup is performed at the beginning of a new Farvision system implementation. 
 Afterward, users cannot delete or add entries—only 
 editing is allowed. Each system can have only one Enterprise. 
 Why do we use 
 Enterprise Config? 
 Enterprise 
 Config lets admins manage enterprise details like password expiry, contacts 
 with divisions and options to add or remove contact, and data retention. 
 Use Case Example: Better 
 Control 
 An 
 Enterprise has a particular individual, Mr. X, as its main contact person. 
 Imagine a scenario where Mr. X has moved away from this role. A new individual 
 is brought in as the new designated contact person, Mr. Y, and this individual 
 wants to make sure that every user resets their password every 90 days, 
 and the password set has to be strong. These changes, i.e. updating the 
 contact person, setting password reset rules, etc., can be updated from 
 the UI itself without requiring Farvision backend support. 
 Steps 
 to use Enterprise Config 
 Navigation to Enterprise Config: Administration > Transaction > Company > Enterprise 
 Config 
 Company Name : This 
 mandatory field is to be filled with the name of the parent or holding 
 organization under which the enterprise belongs to. This field is mandatory 
 and cannot be left empty. 
 Enterprise Name : This 
 mandatory field contains the name of the enterprise the system or portal 
 belongs to. 
 Country : This field is filled with the Country where the 
 Enterprise is located; this is filled during set up and cannot be changed 
 or edited from the UI. 
 Timezone : This 
 field is filled with the time zone the enterprise belongs to; this is 
 filled during set up and cannot be changed or edited from the UI. 
 Allow Weak Password : Checking 
 this option allows the system users to set up any simple password. When 
 this is checked off, then the users must set the password matching the 
 following criteria: 
 · Must be of 8 characters. 
 · Must contain 1 capital character. 
 · Must contain a digit between 0 to 9. 
 · Must contain a special character. 
 FV User PW Expiry : This 
 field defines the number of days before a Farvision user must reset their 
 expiring password. It accepts any numeric integer value representing days, 
 with a default of 180. Each time the password is reset, the counter restarts 
 for that user. A tooltip is also provided for guidance. 
 Portal User 
 PW Expiry : This option defines the number of days 
 before a Portal User must reset their expiring password. It accepts any 
 numeric integer value representing days, with a default of 365. Each time 
 the password is reset, the counter restarts for that user. 
 Contact Person 
 First Name : Enter the First name of the main contact 
 person of the enterprise. This field is mandatory and cannot be left empty. 
 Contact Person 
 Last Name : Enter the Last name of the main contact 
 person of the enterprise. This field is mandatory and cannot be left empty. 
 Contact Person 
 Phone No: This field has 
 two parts: the first part shows the country’s calling code, auto filled 
 from the selected Country field but editable if needed; the second part 
 holds the contact person’s phone number, which is optional. 
 Contact Person 
 Email: This mandatory field 
 contains the email address of the contact person. 
 Login Correspondence 
 Type : This field contains three options: ‘SMS’, ‘Email’, 
 and ‘SMS Email Both’. Based on the selection here, the Login OTP for all 
 the users are generated. 
 Retention 
 Period: 
 This field is non-editable 
 and controls the autodeletion of data when document dates exceed the defined 
 Retention Period. The feature is disabled by default and must be activated 
 via Farvision Support, where both the backend activation and Retention 
 Period update occur (maximum: 100 years). Once enabled, two buttons appear: 
 View Report , 
 which displays records older than the retention period, and Delete Data , which removes those records if 
 any exist beyond the retention threshold. 
 Add 
 New Row 
 Clicking Add New Row opens the 
 ClientCommunication window, where you can enter the Full Name, 
 Phone, Email, and Designation of the enterprise’s point of communication. 
 The Designation field is a dropdown with predefined roles for clarity 
 on the person’s position. 
 Click 
 ‘Submit’ to add new row.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Administration
text:
Business Unit 
 Business 
 Unit 
 Concept 
 Enterprise 
 A business 
 enterprise is always a for-profit entity and consolidation of 
 all companies and groups of companies under its umbrella. Clients 
 can take decisions to create different enterprises when the entrepreneurial 
 ventures and operations will be completely different and if no 
 consolidation is required between multiple entrepreneurial ventures. 
 Business 
 Segment 
 Segment 
 generally used for segmental report, if client has multi directional 
 project like Real estate, contracting, service(s), hospitality 
 under same entrepreneurial ventures and wants consolidate report 
 Business segment wise 
 In 
 the case of a plot project we have noticed that to maintain state 
 registration no (like DTCP) reporting company opens state registration 
 no(s) as a business segment. Multiple plot projects have the same 
 registration number and companies need consolidation of data registration 
 number wise. 
 Zone 
 Zone 
 is always denoted area, like you can open State as Zone also and 
 if a single state has multiple projects under multiple companies 
 for that case by use of zone client can get report zone wise combination 
 of all projects under different companies. 
 Group 
 of Companies 
 Group 
 companies shall be created for reporting of Subsidies companies 
 Company 
 Companies 
 shall always have legal entities. In case of subsidies, company 
 shall create under group of companies 
 Business 
 Unit 
 Every 
 project shall be defined as Business unit based on RERA Registration 
 no for Real Estate project 
 Company 
 has no project, like company created for land owning, a Business 
 Unit shall create under that Company as HO for transactional entry 
 Company 
 has more than one project shall have a business unit named as 
 HO for common expenditure or non-divisible transactional entry 
 Company 
 has one project is not necessary to create any HO 
 If 
 one company has project in other state where the company is registered 
 in different state, hence client has to open that project as a 
 BU due to different GSTIN 
 For 
 the case of land company the nonutilized land shall create as 
 a business unit and based on further utilization the divided land 
 will create as another business unit based on the utilization 
 like as an example : you have 1000 acre land , hence now this 
 1000 acre will create as a BU , after certain time if 50 acre 
 out of earlier 1000 acre may use for certain business development 
 like creation of Mall or any real estate project , for that case 
 this 50 acre shall create as a new business unit 
 For 
 case of the project where contracting type is delivery of trading 
 or manufacture material and any installation and fixing of structure 
 or any type of service delivery as well as company maintain only 
 basis infrastructure at their client site , hence company shall 
 open the same project as business unit if they want reporting 
 for each projects profitability else want complete separate 
 P&L and balance sheet of the project. Otherwise wise companies 
 shall open cost centres for operational ease. 
 For 
 infrastructure or contracting companies those construct buildings 
 like Airport, Hospital, Fly over, Bridge etc. shall open every 
 project as a business Unit. 
 In 
 some cases when contracting can be managed by related contracting 
 company of the same owner hence for managing of sale and construction 
 the same project shall open twice under different companies 
 For 
 post delivery maintenance the same real estate project needs to 
 open as another BU where the maintenance company is different 
 than the developer company under same umbrella 
 Consolidation 
 All 
 the data entry will takes place in Business unit level and will 
 auto consolidate in company , group of company , Business Segment 
 , Zone and Enterprise level 
 Company 
 and group of company is a legal entity , rest shall be created 
 based reporting , transaction and operation ease and for consolidation 
 A 
 business unit is the smallest organizational unit for which individual 
 financial statements are created according to the relevant legal requirements. 
 A company can include one or more company codes. 
 Enterprise 
 can be created first then group of companies or companies are to be created 
 under it. Then other business units can be created subsequently as required. 
 Along with the business unit creation a default inter unit stock transfer 
 ledger head and cost centre is created. 
 Steps 
 to use Business Unit (BU) 
 Navigation 
 to Business Unit (BU):  
 Administration > Transaction > 
 Company > 
 Business 
 Unit (BU) 
 Main Info 
 Code : 
 Enter short description of the Enterprise or Group of Companies or Company 
 or Business Unit as per requirement. 
 For 
 example, a real estate enterprise runs different business units and for 
 a specific business unit named ABC Unit, the code name may be given as 
 ABU. This is a typical example. User has own choice as per requirement 
 and convenience. 
 Description : Enter the name of the Enterprise 
 or Group of Companies or Company or Business Unit. Any name which is relevant 
 and used for business can be given by the user as per choice. 
 For 
 example an Enterprise named ABC Enterprise runs different business units. 
 Now the description of one of the units can be given as 'ABC Unit-i' as 
 per convenience. 
 Type : 
 Select the type (Enterprise, Group 
 of Companies, Company, or Business Unit) from the dropdown; only one Enterprise 
 can be created during initial setup (by the Farvision team), after which 
 it cannot be recreated but can be edited by authorized users. 
 Belongs 
 to : The value to be selected in this field depends on the following 
 conditions 
 If 
 Type= ’Enterprise’, this field becomes inactive (because an Enterprise 
 is considered as parent entity) 
 If 
 Type= ’Group of Companies’, then Enterprise is to be selected (because 
 'Group of Companies' is considered as child of an Enterprise) 
 If 
 Type= ‘Company’, then Group of Companies is to be selected (because 'Company' 
 is considered as child of ’Group of Companies’) 
 If 
 Type= ’Business Unit’, then Company is to be selected (because 'Business 
 Unit' is considered as child of ’Company’) 
 Segment : 
 Search to select business unit segment. Data comes from Setup > Business Unit Segment Setup 
 Zone : 
 Search to select zone. Data comes from Setup > Zone 
 Setup 
 Start 
 Fin Year : Select the financial year in which Enterprise/Group of Companies/Company/Business 
 Unit starts functioning 
 Start 
 Date : Select the date on which Enterprise/Group of Companies/Company/Business 
 Unit starts functioning 
 Discontinue : To 
 discontinue a Business Unit, select it and mark as Discontinue. The unit 
 will no longer appear in transaction entries but can be reactivated by 
 deselecting the option. 
 Note : If a Company is marked 
 as Discontinue, all its tagged Business Units will be hidden from transactions 
 but still visible in reports. 
 Name 
 Code : 
 It displays the value entered in 'Main Info' 
 Description : 
 It displays the value entered in 'Main Info' 
 Effective 
 From : Select the start date of the business unit 
 Address 
 Address 
 details of the business unit are to be provided here 
 Address1 : 
 Enter first line of the address. This generally comprises the building 
 number the street name 
 Address2 : 
 Enter second line of the address which is generally the locality, landmark 
 etc. 
 Address3 : 
 Enter third line of the address, which is generally the locality, landmark 
 etc. 
 Address4 : Enter fourth line 
 for any other information if required. 
 Country : 
 Select or enter the name of the country 
 State : 
 Select or enter the name of the state 
 City : 
 Select or enter the name of the city 
 Postal 
 Code : Enter postal code 
 Latitude : 
 Enter latitude of the business unit 
 Longitude : 
 Enter longitude of the business unit 
 Effective 
 From : Enter the date from which the business unit starts 
 Phone : 
 Enter mobile or land line number to contact 
 Email : 
 Enter the email address 
 Website 
 URL : Enter the website address or link 
 Attachment 
 Tab 
 Click 
 '+ Add New Row' to add Attachment(s): 
 Here 
 we can add attachments which are related to the Enterprise/ Group of Companies/ 
 Company/ Business Unit in question. 
 We 
 can also view or download all previously added documents here. 
 Contact 
 Details 
 of the contact person are to be provided here 
 Name : 
 Enter the name of the contact person 
 Email : 
 Enter the email address of the contact person 
 Phone : 
 Enter the phone number of the contact person 
 Mobile : 
 Enter the mobile number of the contact person 
 Effective 
 From : Enter the effective date 
 Logo 
 Click '+ Add New Row' to add 
 logo 
 Currency 
 Foreign currencies must be converted into a single 
 reporting currency at the current exchange rate. 
 The 
 reporting currency in financial statements and other financial 
 reports are easiest to understand when they are compiled using only one 
 currency. 
 Local : 
 Search and enter the local currency 
 Reporting 
 1 : Search and enter the first reporting currency 
 Reporting 
 2 : Search and enter the second reporting currency 
 Extra Info 
 Tax related information are 
 to be provided here if applicable 
 Change History 
 This 
 tab displays a history of changes made to any entry, including the username 
 of the person who modified it, the time, action, business unit name, and 
 the type of entry. 
 Notes: 
 1) Business unit start date should be less than 
 from company start date 
 When 
 a user attempts to put a start date for a Business unit greater than the 
 company start date it belongs to, the following warning message will evoke. 
 2 ) Business 
 Unit cannot be duplicate 
 T he 
 description of the Business unit and company cannot be duplicate. If found 
 duplicate record the following warning 
 message will evoke. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Document Type
text:
Document Type 
 Company" />
 Document 
 Type 
 Document 
 type allows numbering configuration to be defined for documents. Numbering 
 patterns for documents can be defined at an Enterprise, group of companies, 
 company or BU level. Document numbering normally consists of a prefix 
 which will indicate type of document, followed by the first separator, 
 mostly auto generated serial number, followed by the second separator, 
 and then the suffix. 
 Steps to use 
 Document Number 
 Navigation to Document Type: 
 Administration > Transaction > 
 Company > Documen t Type 
 Description : 
 Enter description of document type. It may be similar to the entry type. 
 Users have sole discretion to use their own description which is convenient 
 for them. 
 Entry 
 Type : Select entry type from drop down list ( Data

 Fiscal 
 Year Template 
 Fiscal 
 year template is to be created in order to define an entity which is required 
 for accounting purposes to formulate annual financial reports . 
 Suppose 'Holiday'. Organizations maintain a Holiday year template to define 
 its holidays in a financial year. 
 Steps to use 
 Fiscal Year Template 
 Navigation to Fiscal Year Template: 
 Administration > Transaction 
 > Fiscal 
 Year > Fiscal Year Template 
 Code : Enter code name of the Fiscal Year 
 Template 
 Period 
 From : Select the starting period ; it is 
 the month from which the Fiscal Year will start. 
 Period 
 To : Select the end period , the month 
 in which the Fiscal Year ends.

 Type : Select 
 year type amongst Accounting/Leave/Bonus/PF/ESI

 Type : Select period type. Period type 
 may be Annually or Half Yearly. 
 CutOff 
 StartDate: T his field in the Payroll module lets 
 the admin set an arbitrary accounting start date. For example, if attendance 
 runs from the 26th of the previous month to the 25th of the current month, 
 then choosing January makes the CutOff Start Date December 26. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Fiscal Year Generation
text:
Fiscal Year Generation 
 Fiscal Year" />
 Fiscal 
 Year Generation 
 The Fiscal Year Generation enables users 
 to automatically create a new fiscal year in the system based on predefined 
 templates and organizational financial structures. 
 Steps to use 
 Fiscal Year Generation 
 Navigation to Fiscal Year Generation: 
 Administration > Transaction 
 > Fiscal 
 Year > Fiscal Year Generation 
 Fiscal Year : Select the fiscal year 
 from drop down list 
 Once the year is chosen, the “Generate 
 Fiscal Year” button must be clicked, in order to begin the fiscal year 
 generation, if not existing already. 
 Mid 
 Term : This option lets 
 the admin set up the enterprise’s first fiscal year in Farvision. Since 
 organizations don’t wait for the next cycle to begin operations, a mid-term 
 year can be created starting on any date (e.g., July 5, 2025 for FY 2025-26), 
 ending March 31, 2026, even though it would normally start April 1, 2025. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

text:

 to User Date Restriction:

 Current 
 Fin Year : If 
 Current Financial Year is selected, 
 entries must be restricted to that year only—so even if Upto 
 Day(s) is set (e.g., 500), the user cannot post transactions in the 
 previous financial year. 
 Cross 
 Fin Year : If Cross Financial 
 Year is selected, entries can be made in both the current and previous

 the previous year as well). 
 Last 
 day of previous year : If 
 Last Day of Previous Year is selected, entries are allowed only 
 in the current financial year and on the last date of the previous year 
 (e.g., for FY 01-04-2022 to 31-03-2023, entries can be made within that 
 range plus 31-03-2022).

 Select 'User' as type

 Select the user to whom the date restriction is to be imposed

 a. Allow backdate entries from today 
 If this restriction type is chosen then Upto Day(s) 
 is to be entered 
 b . Allow entries within specified 
 date range 
 If this restriction type is chosen then 'From Date' 
 and 'To Date' are to be specified 
 c . No Restriction 
 If 
 this restriction type is chosen, nothing needs to be entered. 
 Profile Wise Restriction 
 Type : 
 Select 'Profile' as type 
 Profile : 
 Select the profile to whom the date restriction is to be imposed 
 Restriction 
 Type : Select the restriction type 
 a. Allow 
 backdate entries from today 
 If this restriction type is chosen, then Upto Day(s) 
 is to be entered 
 b . 
 Allow entries within specified date range 
 If this restriction type is chosen, then 'From Date' 
 and 'To Date' are to be specified 
 c . 
 No Restriction 
 If 
 this restriction type is chosen, nothing needs to be entered.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: OTP Based Login
text:
OTP Based Login 
 Security" />
 OTP Based 
 Login 
 OTP now comes to the 
 user’s email for login purposes. 
 Benefits 
 1. One of the 
 benefits of having OTP sent to the user’s email for login purposes is 
 improved security. By sending the OTP to the user’s email, it adds an 
 extra layer of security to the login process as the user would need 
 access to both their password and email account to successfully login. 
 This helps in preventing unautohrised access and reduces the risk of security 
 breaches. 
 2. 
 An other benefit is the convenience 
 of users. Instead of having to rely on receiving OTP through text messages 
 or using a separate authenticator app, having the OTP sent to the user’s 
 email is more convenient as most users already have access to their email 
 accounts on their devices. This simplifies the login process and reduces 
 the need for additional steps, making it easier for users to authenticate 
 their identity and gain access to their accounts. 
 Verification 
 Process 
 · When logging in, users will receive 
 an OTP on their registered email. 
 · Enter the OPT received in the email 
 to successfully log in. 
 Steps to use

 Administration > Transaction > Security

title: User Rights History
text:
User Rights History 
 Security" />
 User Rights 
 History 
 The 
 User Rights History module in Farvision ERP provides a complete 
 audit trail of changes to User and Profile Rights , recording 
 details of every access modification to help administrators track who 
 changed what and when . 
 The 
 User Rights History module maintains an audit log of permission 
 changes, helping identify unauthorized updates, trace access issues, support 
 compliance, and improve accountability by recording who modified rights. 
 Use Case Example 
 Scenario: 
 A 
 project engineer suddenly loses access to the Billing module, affecting 
 daily operations. 
 How User Rights 
 History Helps: 
 The 
 administrator opens the User Rights History module. 
 Searches 
 for the affected user or profile. 
 Reviews 
 the history and finds: 
 The 
 Billing module rights were removed 
 The 
 change was made the previous evening 
 The 
 action was performed by a specific admin user 
 The 
 admin corrects the rights and prevents future mistakes by updating 
 internal processes. 
 Outcome: 
 Faster 
 issue resolution 
 Clear 
 visibility into permission changes 
 Improved 
 security governance and audit readiness 
 Steps 
 to use User Rights History 
 Navigation 
 to User Rights History:  Administration > 
 Transaction > 
 Security > 
 User Rights History 
 The default view 
 shows all the user rights changes throughout the Farvision system. The 
 user can also filter the list using the filters as described below: 
 Module : 
 Using this field the user can select the specific module for which the 
 changes have to be monitored. 
 Menu 
 Item : This field is activated only once the Module is selected and 
 it shows all the menu items belonging to the selected application. 
 Action 
 User: This field signifies the User who took the action of made the 
 changes. If it’s known then the user can select their username and filter 
 the report. This field also comes with a tooltip for user guidance. 
 User : 
 This field signifies the User who received the rights. If it is known 
 then the user can select their username and filter the report. This field 
 also comes with a tooltip for user guidance. 
 Date : 
 This field helps the user to set a date range which can be used during 
 filtering. 
 The 
 resultant data shows the Action Username, the Action Date and Time, the 
 affected username, Category Type (Profile or User), Menu Item and all 
 the rights with both old and new states so that the admin can easily identify 
 the changes. 
 For example, Can Add, Can View, 
 Can Edit, Can Delete, Can Print, Can View Audit Trail, etc 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Pattern is basically the pattern of the input data whether it will be 
 only numeric or character or mix of both. 
 Let

 ABCPE9999C 
 => first 5 characters the 4 digits then one character 
 Pattern, 
 if defined, then the input in this particular field has to follow the 
 same pattern or it will restrict to enter data. 
 To 
 follow the PAN pattern the following expression can be used: 
 [A -Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1} 
 Please 
 follow the explanations: 
 [A-Z]{5} 
 - match five literals which can be A to Z 
 [0-9]{4} 
 - followed by 4 numbers 0 to 9 
 [A-Z]{1} 
 - followed by one literal which can A to Z 
 The 
 following pattern can be use for valid eMail address: 
 "^[_A-Za-z0-9-]+(\\.[_A-Za-z0-9-]+)*@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(\\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)*(\\.[A-Za-z]{2,})$" 
 Explanation 
 is as follows: 
 ^ => 
 * start of the line 
 [_A-Za-z0-9-]+ => 
 * expression inside [ ] indicates string can only contain alphabets, digits 
 (+) must contains one or 
 more 
 ( => * start of group 1 
 \\.[_A-Za-z0-9-]+ => * 
 must be followed by a dot "." and string in the bracket [ ], 
 (+) must contains one or 
 more 
 )* => 
 * end of group 1, (*) indicates that this group is optional 
 @ => 
 * must contains "@" symbol 
 [A-Za-z0-9-]+ => 
 * follow by [] a string that can only contain alphabets, digits 
 (+) must contains one or 
 more 
 ( => * start of group 2 - 
 first level : Top Level Domain checking 
 \\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+ => * follow by a 
 dot "." and string in the bracket [ ], must contains one or 
 more (+) 
 )* => * end of group 2, this 
 group is optional (*) 
 ( => 
 * start of group 3 - second level: Top Level Domain checking 
 \\.[A-Za-z]{2,} => 
 * follow by a dot "." and [] a string that can only contain 
 alphabets with 
 Minimum 
 length of 2 
 ) => * end of group 3 
 $ => 
 * end of the line 
 This 
 type of ‘regular expressions’ can be searched from the cloud for better 
 understanding.

 Approval Workflow has to be defined. If more than one Parallel Approval 
 level to be tagged as a group so that any one user within these group 
 can approve documents without depending upon final approval of previous 
 level (which is also in the same group of parallel approval). But all 
 levels individual final approval has to be completed to move the document 
 out of the Parallel level Group. 
 As 
 per the previous Screen shot, Parallel Level - 1 and Parallel Level - 
 2 are defined one after another so that they can be treated as a Group. 
 Here any one user of Parallel Level - 2 can approve the document before 
 approval done by any user of Parallel Level - 1. But document has to be 
 approved fully for Parallel Level - 1 and Parallel Level - 2 both as per 
 the Rule defined to move the document to Checked By level which is a Sequential 
 Approval Level out of the previous Approval Level Group. 
 As 
 per the above screen shot, Level 1 is a Parallel Level Approval Group 
 consists of two parallel levels (Action name as Parallel Level – 1 and 
 Parallel Level – 2) and then one Sequential approval level (Level 2 with 
 Action Name Checked By) and again Level 3 is another parallel level Approval 
 Group consists of two parallel levels (Action name as Parallel Level - 
 3 and Parallel Level - 4). 
 User 
 of Parallel Level – 2 can approve this document before any one of Parallel 
 Level - 1 approve the document. But approval for both approval action 
 Parallel Level - 1 and Parallel Level - 2 has to be completed to move 
 the document to user(s) of action name Checked By (Level - 2 ). 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

text:

 SMS Template 
To facilitate sending messages to multiple customers with similar content, 
 user can make use of an SMS template. Templates define the structure and

 can be added while sending the message. 
 The

 By’ and ‘Created On’. Clicking each row will open that specific template. 
 Creating 
 SMS Template 
 Click

 Entry

 Main 
 Info 
 Code : 
 Enter DLT Template code for this particular

 for Lead, Money Receipt, Reminder etc.)

 Is

 Template 
 Click on the Template tab to enter the message body.

 by TRAI (keeping comma, full stop, space etc. intact). 
 The message could be a combination of text and variables 
 (available in the Insert 
 option) as approved from TRAI. 
 To Mobile No: Click on “Insert” 
 option to select the recipient’s Mobile No. 
 Template: Here the TRAI 
 approved template to be entered (as it is a transactional SMS). The texts 
 in curly brackets show variable selected from Insert 
 option. 
 SMS 
 sent from Advance search window : By linking the SMS template 
 While creating SMS template the following 
 points to be taken care of : 
 # 
 In case of Transactional SMS : 
 the TRAI approved message has to be exactly copied and pasted in notepad 
 (to avoid any extra properties incorporation from the source reference) 
 then re-copy the same from notepad and paste in the “Template” option. 
 Re-check the template with the original message (TRAI approved) in terms 
 of extra/non space, separators, special character, upper or lower cases 
 etc. manually.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Config - SMS
text:
Config - SMS 
 Communicator" />
 SMS Configuration 
There are two types of SMS, P romotional and Transactional 
 Promotional SMS 
 Transactional SMS 
 Troubleshooting 
 Prerequisite 
 Promotional SMS 
 Promotional SMS cannot be sent to Do Not Disturb 
 (DND) registered numbers. Greetings to employees fall under this head. 
 Promotional 
 sms is applicable for single message to multiple recipients. 
 Transactional 
 SMS 
 Transactional SMS can be sent to DND numbers 
 also. Transactional sms is applicable for single message to single recipient. 
 Demands, reminders for payments, acknowledgement of payment, grant of 
 leave, release of salary, approval alerts, etc. can sent through transactional 
 SMS. 
 Each SMS consists of 160 characters including 
 Sender/Company name, spaces and all other characters. SMS template has 
 to be approved by TRAI before they can be sent. 
 One has to send the desired SMS templates (for 
 different occasions) to the service provider for white listing through 
 TRAI. Once the templates are approved then the same can be used for different 
 occasions. 
 API related 
 to single message to single recipient 
 Example of 
 API Parameters- 
 Variable 
 Value 
 Details 
 User Name 
 loginId 
 This is 
 the userId which you select at the time of registration 
 Password 
 Password 
 Password 
 Sender 
 Senderid 
 You may 
 have multiple sender Ids at website but you need to choose one 
 Sendto 
 9811XXXXXX, 
 9812XXXXXX 
 Write comma 
 separated, 10 digit mobile numbers. You can send at the most 100 
 numbers in one go 
 Message 
 The text 
 you want to send 
 The text 
 you want to send 
 Note: 
 1. 
 Method of post is taken care of by sms provider 
 2. Code is written ASP.NET(C#) in 
 Farvision 
 SMS Template 
 Entry type wise SMS Templates are required to 
 be created to send messages to recipients. 
 Code: Enter DLT Template code for this 
 particular SMS template 
 Description: 
 Enter the description of the template 
 Entry Type: 
 select the entry type as required 
 Language: 
 Select the language to be used in the template 
 Promotional: Please check it, if the SMS template 
 is meant for promotional use (Business development etc.) and the same 
 will not be delivered to the number where DND is activated. 
 For 
 Approval: If checked, then the SMS will 
 be delivered after final approval 
 Template contains SMS message 
 SMS sent from Advance search window: By linking 
 the SMS template 
 SMS Configuration 
 Sms 
 Type: Select SMS type as transactional or promotional whichever 
 is required 
 Provider Name: Enter 
 the service provider’s name, e.g. Vofafone, Airtel , Unicel etc. 
 Sms URL: This URL is to 
 be provided by the SMS service provider which has to be entered here by 
 the user. E.g. If the provider is UNICEL then URL will be http://api.instaalerts.zone/SendSMS/sendmsg.php ? 
 Default: If 
 this box is checked then this particular sms configuration will be worked 
 as default. 
 Click 
 ‘+Add Key’ to add variable and value for the parameters required 
 The 
 following parameters are required to configure the SMS: 
 1. User Name : Get it generated from 
 the service provider (two to three options to be given) 
 Variable can be uname 
 and the value will be confirmed from the provider among the options provided 
 to them (suppose you have provided three options viz. farvisionalert , 
 farvisionmsg , farvisionsms 
 and if the provider confirmed ‘farvisionalert’ then this would be entered 
 as value) 
 2. Password : It will be generated by 
 the service provider 
 Variable can be password 
 and the value will be confirmed from the provider to enter. 
 3. Sender ID : Get it generated from 
 the service provider (two to three options to be given) 
 Variable can be senderid 
 and the value will be confirmed from the provider among the options provided 
 to them (like No.1) 
 4. Destination : It should be the recipients’ 
 mobile number which actually calls from the entity (Lead, Account etc.) 
 Variable can be dest 
 and the value will entered as MobileNo 
 and the option Is From Entity: 
 to be checked. 
 5. Message : This will be the message 
 body (already approved by TRAI) which actually calls from the message 
 template. 
 Variable can be msg 
 and the value will entered as Body 
 and the option Is From Entity: 
 to be checked. 
 User can remove 
 a key which is not required (through X Remove Key). 
 URL Expression Builder: 
 Here all the parameters (Keys) are to be linked 
 with the actual field reference from the database. 
 e.g. 
 uname=click 
 on Insert Template and select uname from drop down and similarly other 
 parameters can also be selected accordingly. Each parameters to be joined 
 with “&” to complete the expression. 
 The 
 expression for the parameters is shown below: 
 Template Id 
 In 
 the Url expression builder, click insert and add the Template Id with 
 ‘&’ as shown in the image below: 
 Template 
 Id has to be mentioned in code field of SMS Template as shown in image 
 below: 
 Following 
 points to be kept in mind while configuring SMS: 
 1. 
 Provider’s URL to be checked properly before deploying 
 2. 
 They Keys (variables) should be assigned with proper value. For example: 
 some providers supply User name and password, some providers supply API_Key, 
 hence the keys should be arranged accordingly. Please refer to the screen 
 shot 
 Normally 
 these 5 Keys and values are 
 minimum compulsory; Key parameters might change depending on the API of 
 the sms provider. 
 Url expression builder 
 Is from Entity : 
 This is normally ticked 
 for the keys whose values are taken from the application. For example, 
 MobileNo and Messages - mobile no is taken from customer ledger and message 
 from sms template. 
 3. 
 Expression builder : All the parameters 
 to be properly tagged from the Template drop down. 
 One 
 can check whether the SMS configuration is proper or not, through the 
 URL expression provided earlier by the service provider with the keys 
 attached to it. 
 Troubleshooting 
 If SMS is not delivered, the following 
 points need to be checked: 
 1. Internet connectivity 
 to be checked in the server. 
 2. FVComm service 
 is properly running or not to be checked in the server. 
 3. In 
 SMS configuration , 
 check the following 
 a. Expression builder: All the parameters 
 to be properly tagged from the Template dropdown. 
 b. 
 Once can check whether the 
 SMS configuration is proper or not, through the URL expression provided 
 earlier by the service provider with the keys attached to it. 
 c. One can check the SMS configuration 
 by hitting the browser with the related URL followed by the keys (with 
 values) configured in the expression builder. 
 Example 1: 
 If the SMS URL 
 is : https://api.alerts.zone.sendSMS/send.php ? 
 The keys can 
 be taken from the expression builder which is as follows 
 uname={{uname}}&pass={{password}}&send={{senderid}}&dest={{dest}}&msg={{msg}} 
The expression to hit the browser for SMS sending will be: 
 https://api.alerts.zone.sendSMS/send.php?uname=UserID&pass=pG!fU9zR&send=FARVSN&dest=8663214520&msg= Dear Mr.ABCD, Thank you for 
 your interest in TESTCITY,Your ID no. 12542,For more info call 022 26350000/ www.xyz.in Regards Demo Realty. 
 i . 
 Proper values to be filled-up in the place of variables then copy the 
 expression 
 and paste it in the browser then press enter to execute. 
 ii. For successful execution the SMS would arrive 
 in the mentioned mobile no (I.e.8663214520) otherwise it would 
 generate an error message. 
 iii. If the expression is correct then no error 
 message will be reflected after sending the SMS from the browser. 
 Example 2: 
 If the SMS URL 
 is : https://japi.instaalerts.zone/httpapi/QueryStringReceiver ? 
 Key : This key is generated in Karix portal 
 Method : The value will be given as “sms” 
 Dest : This will be MobileNo of the recipient 
 represented by “MobileNo” 
 senderId : It will be header ID 
 msg : This will be the message template 
 represented by “Body” 
 Note: Please keep in mind that the texts 
 under the ‘Key’ column are case sensitive, hence the same case has to 
 be maintained while creating the “Url Expression Builder” 
 Please follow 
 the URL expression to test the above API directly hitting the browser: 
 http://japi.instaalerts.zone/httpapi/QueryStringReceiver?ver=1.0&key=XXXXXXXXXXX==&encrpt=0&dest=91XXXXXXXXxx&send=ABCD&text=This 
 is a test message - KARIX&dlt_entity_id=10000000&dlt_template_id= 1000000000 
 4. In 
 Template setup , check 
 the following 
 a. 
 In case of Transactional SMS: 
 the TRAI approved message has to be exactly copied and pasted in notepad 
 (to avoid any extra properties incorporation from the source reference) 
 then re-copy the same from notepad and paste in the “Template” option. 
 b. 
 Re-check the template with 
 the original message (TRAI approved) in terms of extra/non space, separators, 
 special character, upper or lower cases etc. manually. 
 Prerequisite 
 1. DLT 
 Data Registration & Configuration with Karix 
 2. E ach SMS contains 160 characters including 
 your Company name, spaces and all characters. SMS templates 
 have to be approved by TRAI before they can be sent. Gamut will take 
 approval from TRAI. First you have to send template. 
 Sample SMS format 
 to be sent to TRAI for approval 
 "Dear Customer, 
 we have received the payment of Rs 500.00 , by cheque 
 number 123456 dated 06/07/2012 . 
 Cheque payment if any is subject to realization. Thank you.- Gamut 
 Infosystems" 
 Red colored 
 texts denote variable information. In your SMS template, 
 you have to follow the same concept of fixed and variable info (red). 
 You can add/subtract a number of variable fields. 6 
 character sender name has to be chosen by you which is prefixed to the SMS as 
 part of sender ID. (Example in LM-AIRTEL the first two characters 
 are for service provider, followed by - and then 6 characters for your

 Sync Login 
Sync Login is required when a new tenant is created. A 
 new tenant is created with a blank data structure where it requires updating 
 the default data to run the App with bare minimum master data. 
 This feature actually syncs/inserts the required 
 data from predefined data structure (Database) module wise. 
 Application wise Sync is available in this page. 
 If the new tenant is having the login Id as 
 ‘Avi.hod’ then after login with this ID the first step is to sync the 
 default data from Administration module > API Integration > Sync 
 Login. 
 All the modules will appear when sync will be 
 done for the first time. The ‘Proceed To Sync’ button has to be pressed 
 to sync the data all at a time or selectively. 
 By 
 default all the modules will appear as ‘ON’ state. The user can switch 
 off manually to select one or selective module(s) at a time to sync. 
 Clicking 
 on the button the user can make it switch ‘ON’ or ‘OFF’ (for selective 
 sync). 
 One 
 can see the count of default data entity wise by clicking combo box in 
 the right hand side available for sync. The user also has the option of 
 selective sync, Entity wise. Here 
 the screen shot has been given as per example for the module ‘Material’. 
 The 
 modules which are successfully synced would disappear from the Sync screen. 
 On successful completion of sync, all the modules will disappear which 
 means the Sync has been completed.

 Mobile Configuration 
 An Alert notification is sent to Farvision 
 mobile app users when a document is saved. If the workflow rule is enabled

 is approved. Alerts are sent as per scheduled frequency. 
 To enable push notifications, the process

 Farvision Payroll, Farvision SFA, Farvision Task etc.) being used, for 
 both iOS and Android platforms respectively, as users may be

 The frequency

text:

 Document Design 
Users are allowed to customize existing document format or create new documents 
 with the help of Document

 To go to the user-guide click the hyperlink. 
 Report 
 Document Designer User Guide . 
 Introduction 
 Document 
 Designer is a configuration 
 utility in Farvision ERP that enables users to create, customize, and 
 manage document and print formats used across various ERP modules. 
 Using the integrated Document Designer , 
 users can: 
 Create 
 new document print formats or customize existing ones. 
 Copy 
 system-defined templates and modify them as required. 
 Design 
 print formats using text, images, tables, bands, and other components. 
 Configure 
 data sources, tables, columns, and relationships. 
 Apply 
 conditional formatting and business logic. 
 Preview, 
 validate, and save print layouts before deployment. 
 Set 
 preferred print formats as default for specific business processes. 
 Customize 
 supported API-based dynamic data integrations. 
 Key 
 Benefits 
 Business-Specific 
 Formatting 
 Customize 
 layouts according to company branding and operational requirements. 
 Add 
 logos, signatures, QR codes, watermarks, and custom fields. 
 Standardization 
 Maintain 
 uniform document formats across projects, departments, and locations. 
 Ensure 
 consistency in customer-facing communications. 
 Regulatory 
 & Compliance Requirements 
 S upport 
 statutory formats, tax documents, and project-specific agreements. 
 Configure 
 e-Invoicing layouts and compliance-related document outputs. 
 Improved 
 Productivity 
 Eliminate 
 manual editing of documents. 
 Generate 
 accurate prints directly from ERP data. 
 Dynamic 
 Data Presentation 
 Display 
 real-time business information from ERP transactions. 
 Use 
 conditional expressions, calculations, and grouping for better 
 readability. 
 Reduced 
 IT Dependency 
 Business 
 users can modify document layouts without requiring software development. 
 Multiple 
 Format Management 
 Maintain 
 different document versions for various projects, customers, vendors, 
 or business units. 
 Steps 
 to use Document Designer 
 Navigation to Document 
 Designer: Administration à

 Application :

 type selected.

 Steps to create a Document

 Create New Document
